title.narrative: Water as Leverage Academy USA – supporting the knowledge exchange partnership between Florida and Rotterdam and WaL-A USA connection to the Dutch context

description.narrative: Through the Water as Leverage Academy USA, the Government of the Netherlands aims to establish a structured trajectory that stimulates mutual learning, co-creation between Dutch and USA. cities, institutions, and practitioners inspired by Water as Leverage. The Academy provides a platform for mutual learning, cocreation and design, in which USA and Dutch partners co-develop approaches, test methodologies in real-world urban contexts, and jointly reflect on lessons learned to advance urban water resilience. This trajectory aims to contribute to strengthening institutional relationships, enhancing professional networks, and generating knowledge that is relevant to both countries and enriches the Water as Leverage methodology and toolkit. Explicit connections are to be sought with the Netherlands via Dutch platforms (e.g. NL2120), cities (Rotterdam, Amsterdam, others), governmental institutions and research organisations.This assignment aims to further strengthen the potential partnership between Florida and the City of Rotterdam, next to contributing to the landing strip for the knowledge exchange that takes place between the USA and the Netherlands. The activities and deliverables on short term focus on contributing to the Setting the Scene for the shared knowledge agenda, which will be presented mid-April. The Setting the Scene will be presented and elaborated during an event in Miami, for which the contractor is requested to partner with Rotterdam and other key counterparts on the visual materials and other branding that can contribute to the event.The contractor is requested to specifically focus on the learnings the city of Rotterdam can bring to the USA/Florida context, and to contribute to identifying what topics could be further elaborated as part of the further knowledge exchange trajectory between e.g. Miami and Rotterdam, which will be facilitated by the Dutch Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management through the Water as Leverage Academy methodology. Through a Water as Leverage Studio, it is envisaged to connect with academic and other institutions in the USA and the Netherlands. Together with other counterparts, the contractor is requested to develop the Studio methods and partner with Dutch institution(s) to explore the potential to work with a WaL Academy Studio in the light of the USA-NL collaboration.RemarkDue to the transparency with regard to the IATI projects, a non-ODA country is mentioned in this project.
